svg.title: Подтягивания с резинкой — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Resistance-band-assisted pull-up, front-three-quarter view. Each half has its own two-post horizontal pull-up station. Same athlete holds the overhead bar with both hands, slightly wider than shoulders, palms away. A single unmistakable flat elastic loop is hitched to the horizontal bar between hands; its long vertical twin strands descend down in front of the athlete and its bottom cradle securely supports one bent knee in BOTH panels. Start left: body hangs, elbows straight, supported knee bent. Finish right: elbows flexed down beside torso, chin visibly above bar, knee still supported in the same elastic loop. No weights or platform supporting feet. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
